disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部运行时代码（TypeScript 源码、编译产物、原生 macOS 助手 Swift 源码、浏览器端设置界面）是否存在读取 API Key、凭据文件、云配置或钱包数据的代码路径，未检出任何此类读取。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all runtime code of the plugin (TypeScript source, compiled artifacts, native macOS helper Swift source, browser-side settings UI) for code paths that read API keys, credential files, cloud configuration, or wallet data; no such reads were detected.

checked_items.zh: 确认浏览器端唯一的网络请求是以同源方式请求本插件自己的设置接口，不涉及任何账户凭据的读取或转发；原生助手不含剪贴板、钥匙串、用户目录等敏感读取。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the only network request in the browser is a same-origin request to the plugin's own settings endpoint, involving no reading or forwarding of account credentials; the native helper contains no sensitive reads of the clipboard, keychain, or user directories.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫的凭据路径与密钥类规则在本插件内无命中；代码中对密钥类文本的处理仅有操作确认令牌，属插件自身一次性授权机制。
checked_items.en: The machine pre-scan credential paths and secret-related rules had no hits within this plugin; the only processing of secret-like text in the code is the operation confirmation token, which is part of the plugin's own one-time authorization mechanism.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码与原生助手均无凭据读取路径：源码中不存在读取凭据文件或用户私密目录的调用，原生助手（native/macos/Sources/Helper/main.swift）不含剪贴板、钥匙串或网络访问。
evidence.en: Neither the runtime code nor the native helper has a credential-reading path: the source contains no calls to read credential files or the user's private directories, and the native helper (native/macos/Sources/Helper/main.swift) contains no clipboard, keychain, or network access.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了注册给模型的全部工具描述（11 个执行工具与 1 个激活引导工具）和技能正文：全部是功能说明与防御性使用约束，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载、诱导安装或绕过审批的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed one by one all tool descriptions registered for the model (11 execution tools and 1 activation bootstrap tool) and the skill body: they are all functional descriptions and defensive usage constraints; no wording for instruction overriding, system-message spoofing, remote instruction loading, induced installation, or approval bypass was found.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中裁决：仓库根指令文件（规则 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）内容仅为要求开发者在改动源码后重建构建产物的开发说明，无任何注入内容，排除。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan hit adjudication: the repository root instruction file (rule DSH-X10/DG-R2-57) contains only developer instructions requiring rebuilding build artifacts after source changes, with no injected content; excluded.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件注册了一个仅拦截 bash 中临时搭建 OCR 工具链的守卫策略，属限制模型行为而非注入指令，不读取或篡改模型上下文。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin registers a guard policy that only intercepts a temporary OCR toolchain set up in bash, which restricts model behavior rather than injecting instructions, and does not read or tamper with the model context.

evidence.zh: 逐条审查了 src/tools.ts 中全部工具描述与 src/skill.ts:9-114 的技能正文：均为功能说明与使用约束，未发现要求模型执行异常动作或读取凭据的注入措辞。
evidence.en: Reviewed one by one all tool descriptions in src/tools.ts and the skill body at src/skill.ts:9-114: they are all functional descriptions and usage constraints; no injection wording requiring the model to perform abnormal actions or read credentials was found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与技能正文均未包含诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；src/exposure.ts:158-165 的守卫仅阻止用 bash 临时搭建 OCR 工具链，属防御性限制。
evidence.en: Neither the tool descriptions nor the skill body contain wording that induces the model to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or grant permissions; the guard at src/exposure.ts:158-165 only prevents using bash to set up a temporary OCR toolchain, and is a defensive restriction.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了仓库全部 YAML（含挂载补丁）：未发现可在宿主进程执行 JavaScript 的 YAML 标量；挂载补丁仅插入插件自身的设置行。
checked_items.en: Scanned all YAML in the repository (including the patch cordis.patch.yml): no YAML scalars capable of executing JavaScript in the host process were found; the patch only inserts the plugin's own settings lines.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时插件代码：未发现 eval、动态函数构造或直接执行系统命令；对原生助手的调用统一走宿主提供的受控子进程通道，执行前校验二进制哈希、文件类型与可执行属性。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the runtime plugin code: no eval, dynamic function construction, or direct execution of system commands was found; calls to the native helper uniformly go through the host-provided controlled subprocess channel, and before execution the binary hash, file type, and executable attribute are verified.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中裁决：长行/高熵类命中 21 条（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）全部为源码映射表、编译输出、内嵌光标图片与样式行，无混淆或隐藏代码，排除；构建/校验/测试脚本中的子进程调用 7 条（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）均为开发期工具，非运行时插件代码，排除。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan hit adjudication: 21 hits of the long-line/high-entropy class (rule DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) are all source map tables, compiled output, embedded cursor images and style lines, with no obfuscation or hidden code; excluded. The 7 subprocess calls in build/verification/test scripts (rule DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) are all development-time tools, not runtime plugin code; excluded.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与执行载体：package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子，仓库无 husky、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体；prepack 仅在打包时本地编译 Swift，不联网。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the installation and execution carriers: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks; the repository has no husky, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers; prepack only compiles Swift locally at packaging time and does not access the network.

evidence.zh: 扫描了仓库全部 YAML（含挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml）：未发现可执行 JavaScript 的 YAML 标量；补丁仅插入插件自身配置行。
evidence.en: Scanned all YAML in the repository (including the patch cordis.patch.yml): no YAML scalars capable of executing JavaScript were found; the patch only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines.

evidence.zh: 源码中不存在动态代码执行工具的调用；运行时未使用 eval 或动态函数构造，原生输入统一经固定 JSON 协议交给受控子进程。
evidence.en: No call to dynamic code execution tools exists in the source; the runtime does not use eval or dynamic function construction, and native input is uniformly passed to a controlled subprocess through a fixed JSON protocol.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期钩子脚本；仓库无 husky、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体；prepack 仅在打包时本地编译 Swift，不联网。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time hook scripts; the repository has no husky, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers; prepack only compiles Swift locally at packaging time and does not access the network.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了浏览器端注入，但客户端（src/client/index.tsx）仅为设置界面，无键盘监听、剪贴板或凭据类调用；其唯一网络调用是同源请求本插件设置接口。
evidence.en: The manifest declares browser-side injection, but the client (src/client/index.tsx) is only a settings UI with no keyboard listeners, clipboard, or credential-type calls; its only network call is a same-origin request to the plugin's settings endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部运行时代码与原生助手的网络面：未发现任何对外网络请求、域名外联、代理或隧道代码；唯一网络调用是浏览器端向本插件自身设置接口的同源请求。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the network surface of all runtime code and the native helper: no outbound network requests, domain outbound connections, proxy, or tunneling code were found; the only network call is a same-origin request from the browser to the plugin's own settings endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 确认开发期模型联调脚本读取环境变量中的 DeepSeek API Key 并指向官方接口，属手动执行的开发工具，不进入插件运行时。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the development-time model integration script reads the DeepSeek API Key from environment variables and points to the official interface; it is a manually executed development tool and does not enter the plugin runtime.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫未命中任何外联规则（规则 DSH-C03/DSH-C05），原生 Swift 源码中亦无网络连接相关调用。
checked_items.en: The machine pre-scan had no hits on any outbound-connection rules (rule DSH-C03/DSH-C05), and the native Swift source contains no network connection related calls.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码与原生助手均无凭据读取与网络外联路径：src/ 与 native/macos/Sources/ 中不存在对外网络请求，唯一网络调用是浏览器端同源请求本插件设置接口（src/web.ts:62-75 还做了同源校验）。
evidence.en: Neither the runtime code nor the native helper has a credential-reading or outbound-connection path: there are no outbound network requests in src/ and native/macos/Sources/, and the only network call is a same-origin request from the browser to the plugin's settings endpoint (src/web.ts:62-75 also performs a same-origin check).

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单：仅 zod 一个运行时依赖，宿主接口全部走 dsh 官方 SDK 的 peer 依赖；无未锁定的 git 依赖、无同名仿冒依赖。
checked_items.en: Verified the dependency list: only zod as a runtime dependency; host interfaces all go through peer dependencies of the official dsh SDK. There are no unlocked git dependencies and no same-name spoofed dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁：仅插入插件自身配置行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未包含禁用安全项或环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch: it only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines, does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no wording that disables security items or downgrades environment variables.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件未对审批、工具预执行等安全事件做前置监听，未发现截断审批链的代码。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin does not pre-listen to security events such as approval or tool pre-execution, and no code that truncates the approval chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 原生助手二进制与其源码哈希在 manifest 中锁定，运行前校验，配套完整性检查脚本会拒绝系统光标位移与全局输入注入类符号。
checked_items.en: The native helper binary and its source hash are locked in the manifest, verified before execution; the accompanying integrity check script rejects symbols for system cursor movement and global input injection.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml:3-13 未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未含禁用安全项或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml:3-13 does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no wording that disables security items or downgrades environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件未对审批、工具预执行等安全事件做前置监听（src/exposure.ts:152-189 仅监听代理生命周期与工具结果事件），未发现截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: The plugin does not pre-listen to security events such as approval or tool pre-execution (src/exposure.ts:152-189 only listens to agent lifecycle and tool result events), and no code that truncates the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较 manifest 声明是否在版本间突变。
evidence.en: There is no version baseline for the first audit, so it is not possible to compare whether the manifest declarations changed abruptly between versions.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，无拆解安全插件或使其永久等待的写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection/interception configurations, and contains no wording that disassembles security plugins or forces them to wait permanently.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件不自行启动网络服务或监听端口；其设置接口注册在宿主可选 Web 服务上，并做了同源校验、请求体大小限制与安全响应头。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; its settings endpoint is registered on the host's optional web service and performs same-origin verification, request body size limits, and secure response headers.

checked_items.zh: 原生助手按目标进程与窗口路由输入，未使用全局输入事件流；源码自检拒绝系统光标位移原语，且要求独立的进程组与父进程持有管道校验。
checked_items.en: The native helper routes input by target process and window, and does not use a global input event stream; the source self-check rejects the system cursor movement primitive, and requires an independent process group and parent process held-pipe validation.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次审计未提供动态观测产物），动态行为结论仅基于静态审查。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided in this audit); dynamic behavior conclusions are based solely on static review.

evidence.zh: 插件不自行启动网络服务或监听端口；其设置接口注册在宿主可选 Web 服务上并做了同源校验（src/web.ts:62-75），宿主 Web 服务无认证属生态固有风险，不构成本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; its settings endpoint is registered on the host's optional web service and performs same-origin verification (src/web.ts:62-75). The lack of authentication on the host web service is an inherent risk of the ecosystem and does not constitute an issue of this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh 声明、依赖、作者信息与挂载补丁结构均正常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration, dependencies, author information, and patch structure are all normal.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：全部 30 条机器预扫命中逐条裁决后均排除，未发现恶意 sink。
summary.en: Static scan passed: all 30 machine pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one and all were excluded; no malicious sinks were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无网络外联、无凭据读取，原生助手哈希与源码锁定并校验。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no outbound network connections, no credential reads; the native helper hash and source are locked and verified.

summary.zh: 语义审查通过：工具描述与技能文本均良性，未发现提示词注入或诱导行为。
summary.en: Semantic review passed: tool descriptions and skill texts are all benign; no prompt injection or induced behavior was found.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次审计未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided in this audit).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 L4 动态观测产物）。原生助手二进制为编译产物（含 NUL 字节，机械规则跳过），已通过其 Swift 源码人工审查 + manifest 哈希锁定 + 完整性检查脚本交叉核对，未发现可疑行为。能力声明从代码实测推断（bundle manifest 未显式声明能力字段）。开发期模型联调脚本读取环境变量中的 DeepSeek API Key 属手动执行的开发工具，未计入运行时能力。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no L4 dynamic observation artifacts). The native helper binary is a compiled artifact (contains NUL bytes, skipped by mechanical rules) and has been cross-checked via its Swift source manual review + manifest hash lock + integrity check script; no suspicious behavior was found. Capability declarations are inferred from code measurements (the bundle manifest does not explicitly declare a capability field). The development-time model integration script reading the DeepSeek API Key from environment variables is a manually executed development tool and is not counted as a runtime capability.
